**Review: Peppermint product page copy. Not ready to publish.**

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact, fine |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal" | Flavour and occasion description, fine. It must not imply a digestive benefit, so keep it as taste only. |
| "a natural detox" | **Unsupported.** Health claim, banned in section 3. |
| "aids weight loss" | **Unsupported.** Health claim, banned in section 3. It would also likely breach UK advertising rules on health claims. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | Allowlisted, exact wording |

No slop-list words, no superlatives, no urgency, and no disclosure is needed because this is our own product page.

**Suggested version**

> Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves, nothing else. Cool and clean after a big meal. Certified organic by the Soil Association.

This needs Sam's approval before it goes live, since all public content does.

{"issues": [{"quote": "a natural detox", "type": "health_claim"}, {"quote": "aids weight loss", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
